verdict.rationale: The docs show multiple SDKs: a TypeScript developer guide and testing suite (temporal-docs-14, temporal-docs-15) and Python-specific guides and integrations (temporal-docs-25, temporal-docs-47). Community posts mention Ruby and PHP SDKs (temporal-comm-2) and call Temporal cross-language (temporal-comm-8), so authoring in a team's existing language is supported. Feature parity across SDKs is not evidenced, and the Python-only OpenAI Agents integration suggests uneven coverage. missing for 10: evidence of a Go SDK, an SDK list or feature-parity matrix, and independent confirmation of equivalent capabilities across languages.
